name: Tucker Youth Council
what_you_do: Meet monthly, September to April, with city leaders. Explore civic issues, serve as ambassadors for peers, and learn how local government works. Members commit to a full year term.
who_can_apply: High school sophomores, juniors and seniors who live in the City of Tucker.
duration: One-year term. Meetings on the third Wednesday, September to April.
deadline_text: The 2026 council application closed Aug 19, 2026. Meetings: 9/16, 10/21, 11/18, 1/20, 2/24, 3/17, 4/21, with optional dinner 4/26 and celebration 5/7. The next application is not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the online application on the city's Youth Council page. Members may reapply at the end of their term.
notes: The page lists no direct phone or email; it links to the city's Contacting the City page. The page does not post the next application date. Unpaid, so no work permit.
